{{Quote|An explosion bright as a star. A forest world, intrepid defenders, escaping ships, and… ''you'', I think, somehow at the center of it all. Skywalker, it won't matter if you find them. It won't matter if you find and kill every Jedi who survived Order Sixty-Six. I understand now… the Force will never die.|[[Roan Shryne]]'s [[Force vision|vision]] of the Battle of Endor in [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]]|<ref name="Dark Lord">''[[Dark Lord: The Rise of Darth Vader]]''</ref>}}
The '''Battle of Endor''', also known as the '''Battle of the Second Death Star'''<ref name="AaS">''[[Assault at Selonia]]''</ref>, fought between the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] and the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] in [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]], was one of the largest and most important engagements of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. It signified the decline of the Empire, with the [[Death/Legends|deaths]] of [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] and [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]], as well as many other major Imperial leaders, and the destruction of the [[Death Star II/Legends|Death Star II]].

Plans for the battle began after the Rebels learned that the Empire was building a new [[Death Star/Legends|Death Star]] above the [[Endor/Legends|forest moon]] of [[Endor (planet)/Legends|Endor]]. In addition, spies had informed Rebel leadership that not only were the Death Star's defense systems incomplete, but also that the [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] himself would be overseeing the completion of the [[Superweapon/Legends|superweapon's]] construction. Seeing an opportunity to strike a crippling blow to the Empire, the Alliance planned an attack on the incomplete space station. One group of Rebels would fight on the [[Moon/Legends|moon's]] surface in an attempt to destroy the shield generator protecting the Death Star, while another would fight in [[Realspace/Legends|space]], assaulting the battle station in Endor's [[Orbit/Legends|orbit]] once the protective shield was deactivated. Unbeknownst to the Rebels, Palpatine had deliberately leaked false information to them—the Death Star was, in actuality, operational and ready for combat. The Emperor also had a [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]] of [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyers]] waiting to ambush and destroy the [[Alliance Fleet/Legends|Rebel Fleet]] upon its arrival.

On the ground, a group of Rebels led by [[General/Legends|General]] [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] fought the Imperial [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]] stationed on the forest moon in an attempt to destroy the [[Deflector shield generator/Legends|shield generator]] protecting the Death Star. Meanwhile in space, the Alliance Fleet, led by [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Gial Ackbar/Legends|Gial Ackbar]] and aided by [[Lando Calrissian/Legends|Lando Calrissian]] in the [[Millennium Falcon/Legends|''Millennium Falcon'']], battled the Empire's [[Imperial Navy/Legends|naval forces]] and attacked the battle station. However, the Empire held a significant advantage in the [[Starfighter combat/Legends|space battle]] due to the massive fleet of Star Destroyers defending the battle station. In addition to the numerical advantage of the Imperials, [[Darth/Legends|Darth]] Sidious's [[Battle meditation/Legends|battle meditation]] further helped the Imperials by scattering the attacking Rebel forces.

Shortly, the Rebels realized that they had been tricked, for the Death Star's weapon systems were already operational. Despite this quick realization, the Rebel fleet still suffered severe losses through the Death Star's [[Superlaser/Legends|superlaser]], secretly controlled by [[IG-88A/Legends|IG-88]], who also planned to [[Droid Revolution|overthrow]] the Empire. With the [[Endor strike team/Legends|strike team]] on the ground still struggling to take down the shield, the Rebels turned the tide of the battle with the help of the native [[Ewok/Legends|Ewoks]], gained access to the generator command bunker, and rigged it with explosives. After Solo's team took down the shield generator, several squadrons of Rebel [[Snubfighter/Legends|snubfighters]] led by Calrissian and [[Wedge Antilles/Legends|Wedge Antilles]] attacked the Death Star's [[Reactor/Legends|reactor core]].

At the same time, Darth Vader brought [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] to the Emperor in order to turn his son to the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side]] of [[The Force/Legends|the Force]]. Skywalker [[Lightsaber duel/Legends|dueled]] his father in the [[Emperor's throne room]], and used his anger to emerge as the victor. However, after Skywalker refused to give in to Sidious's demands and kill Vader, the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Torture/Legends|tortured]] the young Jedi using his [[Force lightning/Legends|Force lightning]]. Unwilling to see his son die, Vader saved his son and killed his [[Sith Master/Legends|master]] by grabbing him and throwing him down the Death Star's reactor shaft. He had redeemed himself, becoming Anakin Skywalker once again and fulfilling his role as the [[Chosen One/Legends|Chosen One]], though due to the damage inflicted by the Emperor's Force lightning, he died in the act.

Soon after, Calrissian and Antilles destroyed the Death Star's reactor core, setting off a chain reaction that obliterated the entire battle station, along with IG-88 and the other Imperials inside it. The Rebel fleet escaped its destruction, as did Skywalker. The Imperials, having seen the destruction of the Death Star and no longer having Sidious's battle meditation on their side, retreated. On Endor, Skywalker and the others celebrated their freedom, as did the inhabitants of many other [[Planet/Legends|worlds]]. With its two main leaders dead, the Empire began its long decline, with multiple [[Warlord/Legends|warlords]] fighting for power. Many Rebel heroes of the battle, such as Wedge Antilles, were hailed as liberators, and they helped form the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] shortly thereafter. While the actions of the battle did not end the war, they marked the beginning of the end for the Empire and also restored balance to the Force.

==Prelude==
{{Quote|Everything is proceeding as I have foreseen.|Palpatine|audio=AsIHaveForeseen-ROTJ.flac|<ref name="ROTJ" />}}
[[File:Breaking_Ground.png|thumb|left|250px|The Empire begins construction of its Endor planetary base.]]
In [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]], the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] learned that the Empire was constructing a second [[Death Star/Legends|Death Star]] space station under the supervision of [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] [[Tiaan Jerjerrod/Legends|Tiaan Jerjerrod]]. The Alliance leadership soon discovered the Empire had corrected the design flaws that had been exploited in the original [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|Death Star]] at the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]]. It was decided that the station would have to be destroyed before it was completed, as it would be virtually impossible to stop after it became fully operational.<ref name="ROTJ" />

As part of [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Galactic Emperor Palpatine's]] preparations for the upcoming battle, he arranged for [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]], his [[Sith apprentice/Legends|Sith apprentice]] and the [[Supreme Commander (Galactic Empire)/Legends|Supreme Commander]], to arrive from Coruscant to Endor in order to ensure with the main overseer of its construction, Moff Tiaan Jerjerrod, that the [[Death Star II/Legends|Death Star II's]] weapons systems were completed by the time the [[Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] arrived to inspect the station. In large part due to insufficient manpower, including the deaths of several construction crews in an incident where a stormtrooper infiltrator droid self-destructed the second it was potentially discovered from objects falling, as well as the news that Palpatine was arriving on the station with the implied threat of facing a severe punishment should he be delayed any further, Jerjerrod vowed to redouble their efforts to ensure that the station's systems were completed on schedule.<ref name="ROTJ" />

In the meantime, when the Emperor was due to arrive at the battle station, Vader commanded an assembly of officers and stormtroopers to greet Palpatine's shuttle when it arrived, many of whom arrived for the rare opportunity to meet the Emperor face-to-face, as the overlord rarely left the confines of the [[Imperial Palace/Legends|Imperial Palace]] on Coruscant.<ref name="Complete Visual Dictionary">''[[Star Wars: The Complete Visual Dictionary]]''</ref> Afterwards, Palpatine arrived on the station and was met with a parade of fighters and a flanking of troops and technicians.<ref name="Visual Dictionary">''[[Star Wars: The Visual Dictionary]]''</ref><ref name="ROTJ" /> Vader, while accompanying his master when marching to the throne room, informed Palpatine that the systems would be completed on schedule. After this notification, Palpatine, sensing Vader was still trying to search for Skywalker, told him that the latter was seeking him out, and that due to his growing power, they could only draw him to the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side]] together. The Emperor cackled in triumph as he believed that everything was proceeding according to his predictions.<ref name="ROTJ" />

After [[Rescue of Han Solo/Legends|rescuing]] [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] from the clutches of [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba the Hutt]] on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]], [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]], while the others regrouped with the Rebel Fleet, traveled to [[Dagobah/Legends|Dagobah]] to complete his Jedi training with Grandmaster [[Yoda/Legends|Yoda]]. When he arrived, however, he found the ancient Jedi succumbing to the ravages of illness and old age. In response to Luke's pleas, Yoda informed him that he required no more training, but that, to truly achieve the rank of Jedi Knight, he had to confront [[Darth/Legends|Darth]] Vader one last time.<ref name="ROTJ" /> Luke, who had been told by Vader during their [[Duel on Cloud City/Legends|duel a year before]] that the latter was his father,<ref name="Star Wars Episode V: The Empire Strikes Back">{{Film|V}}</ref> questioned Yoda as to the truth of Vader's revelation. Yoda reluctantly confirmed that Vader was indeed Luke's father as Luke had suspected, conflicting the young Jedi.<ref name="ROTJ" />

[[File:Home_One_briefing_room.jpg|thumb|235x235px|The Rebels plan their attack aboard Admiral Ackbar's ''Home One''.]]<div style="float:right"></div>
Through intelligence operations that cost the lives of many [[Bothan/Legends|Bothan]] [[Spy/Legends|spies]], the Alliance learned that the space station was [[Orbit/Legends|orbiting]] the forest moon of [[Endor/Legends|Endor]]. In addition, the Rebels learned that, although the station was protected by a powerful [[Deflector shield/Legends|deflector shield]] projected from a base on the moon, the station's weapons were not yet ready for service. Furthermore, they also learned from the Emperor's datapad, stolen in the [[Battle of Korriban (Galactic Civil War)|Battle of Korriban]],<ref name="RS" /> that the Emperor was personally supervising the final construction of the station. Destroying the station while he was aboard would deliver a crushing blow to the Galactic Empire, perhaps the blow that would free [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].<ref name="ROTJ" /> Mon Mothma, the leader of the Rebel Alliance, gave a speech regarding the information with a heavy heart. A few moments prior to her speech, Mothma had received the letter from her then-deceased son, [[Jobin]], who fell during the [[Battle of Hoth/Legends|Battle of Hoth]] months earlier, and learned of her son's fate from General [[Crix Madine/Legends|Crix Madine]].<ref name="Entrenched">{{StoryCite|story=Entrenched|book=Star Wars: Visionaries}}</ref>

Determining the opportunity too vital to pass up, the Alliance planned a two-pronged attack. A [[Endor strike team/Legends|commando squad]], led by General Han Solo and coordinated by General [[Brenn Tantor]], a former Imperial general who had set up the shield generator, would land on the moon in a stolen Imperial [[Shuttle/Legends|shuttle]] and disable the base's deflector shield projector. This would allow a Rebel fleet to attack and destroy the Death Star.<ref name="Star Wars: Force Commander" /> Although the preparations to the shuttle in question, the ''Tydirium'', including bringing in the task force, were complete, Solo did not find a command crew for the vessel in time, before Chewbacca and [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]] volunteered. Skywalker, who had just arrived at the ''Home One''{{'s}} briefing room after secretly training to become a Jedi at Dagobah, volunteered as well.<ref name="ROTJ" />

Meanwhile, Rebel ships launched an [[Battle of Sullust (4 ABY)|attack on Imperial forces]] near the planet of [[Sullust/Legends|Sullust]] in an attempt to lure Imperial ships away from Endor. While the Rebels accomplished their objectives, it proved to be a miscalculation made by them, as Palpatine had devised a strategy to maintain the majority of the fleet close to Endor.<ref name="RS" /> There, the fleet would provide security and support for the second Death Star instead of engaging the Rebel Fleet, a strategy not revealed until the commencement of the battle above Endor's forest moon.<ref name="ROTJ" />

The Rebels were unwittingly falling into a trap devised by the Emperor. In an attempt to effectively eliminate the Rebellion, Palpatine planned on drawing the Alliance to Endor using simple disinformation: he hid the fact that the station's primary defense systems were already operational. Darth Vader's personal fleet, [[Death Squadron/Legends|Death Squadron]], was reinforced to a strength of over thirty [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyers]], assembled at Endor to await the Rebel attack. With Death Squadron hidden on the far side of the moon and an elite legion of Imperial troops standing by on the moon's surface near the shield generator, Palpatine was ready to crush the Alliance Fleet once and for all. Elsewhere in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]], the Empire assembled massive invasion fleets on the borders of the [[Calamari sector/Legends|Calamari sector]] and Mon Mothma's homeworld of [[Chandrila/Legends|Chandrila]]. Palpatine planned to smash [[Gial Ackbar/Legends|Ackbar's]] fleet at Endor between the Death Star and Death Squadron while his fleets fixed the Mon Cals and Chandrila in place. Once the Death Star was completed, it would move to these worlds and destroy them to finally end the Rebellion.<ref name="EGTW" />

As the Endor strike team arrived in the [[Endor system/Legends|Endor system]], they ran into several tense moments after they gave the de facto leader of Death Squadron, Admiral [[Firmus Piett/Legends|Firmus Piett]], via [[Controller/Legends|Controller]] [[Jhoff/Legends|Jhoff]] the confirmation codes to clear the Endor shield, as they were, although technically still functional, old codes. Because of these tense moments, just before Piett gave them the go-ahead, Solo verbally expressed concern and planned to abort the operation as soon as possible. However, as the strike team approached the moon, Luke felt Vader's presence on board the Star Dreadnought ''Executor'', which was functioning as a command ship for the Death Star's ostensibly light security screen. He quickly realized that, if he could sense Vader's presence, then Vader could likely sense his in return, and that as such he was endangering the mission by being there. As Luke had feared, Vader did feel his son's presence aboard the shuttle ''Tydirium'' and allowed it to land on Endor for that reason. Before leaving to inform the Emperor of this development, he told Piett, when asking if he should not allow them in, that he intended to deal with them personally.<ref name="ROTJ" />

Unknown to Luke at the time, the entire operation was a web of deception set up by Emperor Palpatine as a trap to destroy the Rebel Alliance. Both Vader and the Emperor were in fact expecting Luke to arrive, and each hoped to turn him into a new Sith apprentice. However, Sidious failed to sense Luke on board the ''Tydirium'', only discovering this when Vader disobeyed prior orders to remain on the ''Executor'' and reported his presence inside the Rebel vessel in person. The Sith Master ordered Vader to go to Endor, anticipating that Luke would surrender in an attempt to bring Vader back to the [[Light side of the Force/Legends|light side]]. Knowing this, Sidious planned to turn the young Jedi to the dark side, installing the youth as his new apprentice,<ref name="ROTJ" /> in much the same manner that he had Anakin supplant [[Count/Legends|Count]] [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]] at his side [[Battle of Coruscant/Legends|23 years before]].<ref name="ROTS">{{Film|III}}</ref>

==The battle==
===The ground assault===
{{Quote|An entire legion of my best troops awaits them.|[[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]]|<ref name="ROTJ" />}}
The Rebels took the Emperor's bait, and a squad headed to Endor on board the captured shuttle [[Tydirium/Legends|''Tydirium'']], [[Mission to Prefsbelt IV|stolen]] by [[Wedge Antilles/Legends|Wedge Antilles]] on [[Prefsbelt IV/Legends|Prefsbelt IV]].<ref name="SW:RSII:RL" /> After using a stolen clearance code that, while outdated, the [[Executor/Legends|''Executor'']] cleared, Solo piloted the shuttle to the moon's surface. At that time, Luke had second thoughts about coming on the mission after [[Force sense/Legends|sensing]] that Vader was on the ''Executor''; he feared Vader would sense his presence through the Force and endanger the entire operation. Sure enough, Vader had indeed detected his son and ordered the ship to pass before reporting back to the Emperor.<ref name="ROTJ" /> At the same time, [[Renegade Squadron/Legends|Renegade Squadron]] also slipped past the planetary shield. Solo's team landed, with Renegade Squadron landing some ways away.<ref name="RS" />

After landing on the planet, Solo's team traversed through the forest until they encountered two Imperial [[Scout trooper/Legends|scout troopers]], Corporal [[Avarik]] and and Sergeant [[Elsek]]. Solo attempted to sneak up on the soldiers, but the attempt backfired when he accidentally stepped on a twig, giving away his position and forcing him to take them out openly. The commotion alerted two more nearby scout troopers, Sergeant [[Barich]] and his partner, who escaped on speeder bikes to report to the main Imperial base. Luke Skywalker and Leia Organa, mounting the speeder bikes of the troopers Solo had felled, left in pursuit. During the chase, Luke Skywalker jumped onto the speeder bike of Barich's partner and knocked him off. At that moment, another two scout troopers joined the chase, Corporal [[Drelosyn]] and Corporal [[Misik]]. Skywalker ordered Leia Organa to continue her chase after the Barich while he took the other two speeders. Barich knocked Leia off her bike, crashing it, although he died shortly thereafter while looking back to observe the bike's explosion, not paying attention to the forest in front of him and causing him to crash into a fallen tree.<ref name="ROTJ" /> During Luke's pursuit, the Imperial reinforcement arrived on the chase and assisted Misik to engage Skywalker before he destroyed several of their speeders.<ref name="Rebel Strike" />
{{GameMechanics|legends=1|Star Wars: Rogue Squadron III: Rebel Strike}}
Midway through his pursuit of the scout troopers, Skywalker stumbled upon and procured a case of [[homing concussion missile]]s.
{{EndGame}}
After shooting down Drelosyn with his bike's blasters, Luke eventually encountered Misik, and they attempted to ram each other away. However, it resulted in them locking their speeders together. Eventually, Luke jumped off the speeder after disengaging. Misik then attempted to kill Luke by firing at him. However, Luke deflected the blaster fire with [[Luke Skywalker's green lightsaber/Legends|his lightsaber]] before he quickly sliced Misik's speeder bike's steering vane as he rode post, dooming Misik to spin out of control and eventually collide with a tree, killing the corporal. Luke then departed to regroup with the task force.

After being separated during their pursuit of the Imperials through the forest, Skywalker returned to find Organa had not. Sending the rest of the strike team to continue on to their objective, and vowing to rendezvous with them at 0300, Skywalker, along with Solo, Chewbacca, [[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO]], and [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]], left to search for Organa. However, the search was sidetracked when Chewbacca, due to undergoing "olfactory delirium" from the scent of a [[Unidentified tusked creature|dead animal carcass]], unwittingly trapped his comrades in a net, set by the moon's indigenous population, the [[Ewok/Legends|Ewoks]]. After R2-D2 brashly freed them by using his buzzsaw accessory, they were surrounded by the Ewoks, who ended up worshiping C-3PO, believing him to be a deity known as the [[Golden One/Legends|Golden One]] from their pantheon mythology, resulting in the Ewoks taking the group prisoner.<ref name="ROTJ" />

Meanwhile, Organa, unconscious after crashing her speeder bike, was awoken by a native Ewok named [[Wicket Wystri Warrick/Legends|Wicket Wystri Warrick]]. Unsure whether she was friend or foe, Wicket was initially cautious of Organa because she was human and the local stormtroopers had killed many Ewoks. However, after the two were ambushed by scout troopers, including corporal [[Oberk]], and worked together to overcome them, she had gained his trust and he took her back to his village. There she was reunited with Han, Luke, Chewbacca, C-3PO and R2-D2 after they had been captured by the Ewoks and taken to [[Bright Tree Village/Legends|Bright Tree Village]], where they were to be sacrificed. The Rebel heroes would have met their end had Skywalker not convinced the Ewoks to help them by [[Telekinesis/Legends|levitating]] C-3PO on his god-throne. After explaining their story, the Rebels were anointed as official members of the Ewok's [[Bright Tree Village tribe|tribe]]. One of the Ewoks also explained that he knew the quickest way to the Endor shield generator, with Han Solo telling C-3PO, shortly after the latter stated this, to ask which way, as well as their need of their weapons back and fresh supplies.<ref name="ROTJ" />

That night, Luke Skywalker, after asking about her [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|real mother]], revealed to Leia Organa that she was his sister and that Darth Vader was their father, information that shocked the Princess. Skywalker, sensing that Vader had felt his presence and had come to the moon in search of him, left the Ewok village with a dual purpose: To protect his friends from discovery, and to surrender to Vader in an attempt to turn him from the dark side. Solo, unaware of this revelation when finding her outside shortly thereafter, tried to find out why Organa was upset, eventually asking irritably whether she wanted to talk to Skywalker when she was reluctant to divulge her discovery before consoling her. Afterwards, Skywalker surrendered to a platoon of Imperial soldiers and was boarded onto an [[All Terrain Armored Transport/Legends|AT-AT]] to be delivered to the main base, denying that any other Rebels were in the area. However, neither Vader nor the commander of the AT-AT, [[Igar/Legends|Igar]], believed his claim, and with Vader's permission, Igar sent a search party for any Rebels in the area. Skywalker then appealed to Vader to escape the Emperor and return to the light side of the Force. Vader dismissed him, believing he was far beyond any chance at redemption.<ref name="ROTJ" />

In the meantime, Major Derlin and the rest of the team dodged Imperial patrols, then stopped to make camp as night fell. Shortly after starting their first sleeping shift, the camp sensors picked up an [[All Terrain Scout Transport/Legends|AT-ST]] moving in on their position. Derlin had Corporal [[Dansra Beezer|Beezer]] jam its transmissions so it couldn't call for help, then Lieutenant [[Greeve (Human)|Greeve]] took out both of the scout walker's searchlights. Finally, Corporal [[Delevar]] used the Caspel launcher to pop a smoke canister through one of the viewports in the head, forcing the crew to abandon the vehicle. Forcing the pilot to make check-in calls to explain its absence, the team kept their rendezvous with General Solo without alerting Imperial forces.<ref name="Galaxy Guide 5: Return of the Jedi">''[[Galaxy Guide 5: Return of the Jedi]]''</ref> [[Unidentified Rebel trooper (Endor)|One of the team members]] briefly stepped away to relieve himself and got lost.<ref name="Marooned">{{Tales|22|Marooned}}</ref>

[[File:KilledStormtroopers.jpg|thumb|right|250px|Stormtroopers killed by Rebel troopers inside the Imperial bunker of Endor]]
{{Quote|This forested moon fits Lord Vader's requirements perfectly. Only conceivable threat is presented by furred, dwarf bipeds. Their technology is laughably primitive. The spears, bows, and slings of these pathetic savages pose no threat to disciplined Imperial stormtroopers. We can safely ignore these contemptible little fur-balls.|Excerpt from report by Imperial reconnaissance unit IX3244-B|<ref name="The Star Wars Sourcebook">''[[The Star Wars Sourcebook]]''</ref>}}
The next day, the Rebels, fully rendezvoused with each other, accompanied by a force of Ewok warriors, descended upon a secret entrance to the Imperial bunker. While planning how to infiltrate the bunker, one of the Ewoks, [[Paploo/Legends|Paploo]], in an attempt to create a diversion, snuck onto a nearby speeder bike and raced away into the forest, initially causing the Rebels some concern due to its high risk of exposing them. After most of the scout troopers guarding the entrance raced away in pursuit of the Ewok, Solo and the rest of the Rebels easily gained entrance to the bunker, including luring the remaining trooper towards the waiting task force and forcing him to surrender, and, after capturing the Imperials inside, set explosives. Their victory was short-lived, however, as they were soon ambushed by another contingent of Imperials led first by [[Colonel/Legends|Colonel]] [[Dyer/Legends|Dyer]] and, after General Solo shoved him beyond a railing to his death, by [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] [[Renz/Legends|Renz]], who led them out of the bunker, where they were met by hundreds of stormtroopers and AT-STs. With the hopes of the Rebel task force all but dashed, the concealed Ewok force surrounding the bunker clearing launched a furious ambush, stunning the Imperials who had already dismissed them as primitive natives.<ref name="ROTJ" /> Meanwhile, Renegade Squadron heard over their comlinks that Solo was surrounded, and they rushed to his rescue. First, they liberated an Ewok village captured by stormtroopers. Finally, Renegade Squadron halted the repairs on an AT-AT that had been crippled by Solo's strike team earlier.<ref name="RS" />

Although initially surprised by the ambush, [[Tempest Force/Legends|Tempest Force]] regained the upper hand, and squads of stormtroopers pursued the Ewoks into the forest. Despite being outnumbered by the natives, the stormtroopers with their armor and advanced weapons forced the Ewoks back, and Imperial AT-ST scout walkers decimated Ewok holdouts. The Ewoks tried, but were unsuccessful with, a number of tactics, such as using [[Hang-glider/Legends|gliders]] to drop stones on the walkers, and trying to trip them with ropes.<ref name="ROTJ" />

Hoping to take the upper hand, a pair of Ewoks, led by the [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] Chewbacca, captured [[Tempest Scout 2/Legends|Tempest Scout 2]], one of the AT-ST walkers, throwing Lieutenant [[Watts]] out of the scout walker in the process, as well as knocking out [[Major/Legends|Major]] [[Marquand/Legends|Marquand]].<ref name="Endor Limited">{{CCG|set=Endor Limited|cardname=Major Marquand}}</ref>

{{GameMechanics|legends=1|Star Wars: Rogue Squadron III: Rebel Strike}}
Shortly after hijacking Tempest Scout 2, Chewbacca, while aiding the Ewoks and destroying Scout 2's former comrades, recovered a case of [[homing cluster missile]]s, stumbling upon it due to it being camouflaged.
{{EndGame}}

[[File:GrandTheftATST-RotJAVA.png|thumb|left|235x235px|Chewbacca mans a captured AT-ST.]]
Renegade Squadron also sent at least one of their men into a walker.<ref name="RS" /> The tide of the battle began to turn as Chewbacca used this AT-ST to take out isolated Imperial units as well as another Imperial walker. The sight of this rallied the remaining Ewoks, who had been retreating into the woods, and they doubled their efforts behind the stolen AT-ST. Meanwhile, at the bunker door, the Rebels tried to break in again, but a new security code was put in place by the Imperials during the Rebels capture. Leia called for R2 to open the lock, but the droid was shot and disabled by a stormtrooper while attempting to do so. As Solo tried to unlock the door manually, Leia was injured by a shot to the arm. Two stormtroopers then attempted to capture Han, Leia, C-3PO, and a damaged R2, only to get shot by Leia, who had concealed a gun on her person.<ref name="ROTJ" />

With the Ewoks springing a number of more successful traps, they, along with Chewbacca's commandeered AT-ST, defeated the remaining scout walkers, before proceeding back to the entrance of the bunker to meet the Rebel strike team. The strike team was concerned with the AT-ST's arrival until Chewbacca popped out of the hatch. Solo initially ordered for the Wookiee to treat Organa's injuries, although he changed his mind when the AT-ST's presence gave him an idea of how to breach the bunker: With the Imperials in disarray, Solo posed as Marquand, informing the Imperials within the bunker via comlink that the battle was over, that the Rebels were fleeing into the woods, and that reinforcements were needed to continue the pursuit. Three squads of reinforcements were sent to help search for the Rebels. The Rebels, however, were waiting at the bunker door, and the Imperial reinforcements, sorely outnumbered and under the guns of an AT-ST, surrendered to the combined force of Rebels and Ewoks. The Rebels infiltrated the Imperial facility, cleared out the remaining personnel, and destroyed the bunker with several [[Proton grenade/Legends|proton charges]].<ref name="ROTJ" /> Renegade Squadron prevented any stormtroopers from entering the bunker while they did this.<ref name="RS" /> [[Storm commando/Legends|Storm commando]] [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Sarkli]] attempted to intercept Solo and stop him from escaping the burning bunker, but failed and was shot dead, with Solo also stating that Sarkli had chosen the wrong side as the Empire was finished (referring to Sarkli's earlier [[Defense of Ralltiir|defection]] from the Rebel Alliance). Upon rushing out of the doomed bunker, Solo ordered everyone to clear the immediate area from the impending explosion. The destruction of the facility brought down the deflector shield surrounding the forest moon and the Death Star. At the same time, [[X2]], a former elite [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone trooper]] who turned against the Empire, also participated in the battle. He met up with [[Col Serra]] of Renegade Squadron on the surface of the moon. There, he fought a group of Imperial troopers and freed several Ewoks before shutting down the Imperial communications network.<ref name="ES" /> The space station was now vulnerable to attack, and the next phase of the battle began.<ref name="ROTJ" />

===The space battle===
{{Quote|Admiral! We have enemy ships in sector 47!''"<br />"''It's a trap!|[[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Verrack/Legends|Verrack]] and [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Gial Ackbar/Legends|Ackbar]]|audio=ItsATrap-ROTJ.flac|<ref name="ROTJ" />}}
[[File:The_Final_Battle_SBI.png|thumb|right|250px|Alliance Fleet approaches the Death Star.]]
At the same time the commandos were captured by the Imperials, the [[Alliance Fleet/Legends|Alliance Fleet]] exited from [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] and moved to attack the apparently unshielded Death Star. General [[Lando Calrissian/Legends|Lando Calrissian]] and his co-pilot, the [[Sullustan/Legends|Sullustan]] [[Nien Nunb/Legends|Nien Nunb]], noticed that sensors were not detecting the residue of an active or a deactivated shield, which meant that the Empire was jamming the Alliance and the shield was likely still up.<ref name="ROTJ" /> They pulled up to avoid hitting the shield, though some pilots did not do so in time and crashed into it.<ref name="ROTJn" /> The Alliance Fleet spotted a group of Star Destroyers moving toward them, and Ackbar realized that the Empire had anticipated the imminent attack, staging a trap to capture and crush the Rebellion by sandwiching the Alliance Fleet between [[Death Squadron/Legends|Death Squadron]] and the Death Star II. [[Immobilizer 418 Interdictor-class Heavy Cruiser|Interdictor cruisers]] moved into position to [[Gravity well projector/Legends|project]] [[Gravity well/Legends|gravity wells]], which trapped the Alliance Fleet in-system.<ref name="EGTW" /><ref name="ROTJ" />

[[TIE/ln space superiority starfighter/Legends|TIE fighters]] and [[TIE/IN interceptor/Legends|TIE interceptors]] were deployed from the Imperial Fleet to engage the Rebel fighters and [[Capital ship/Legends|capital ships]]. Some of the smaller warships were destroyed by the TIEs, and both fleets engaged from a distance. Eventually, TIE bombers joined the fray, forcing the various squadrons to fight them before they reached the fleet. They then had to protect the medical frigate, which was heavily damaged from the earlier attacks by the TIE bombers and TIE fighters.<ref name="SW:RSII:RL" /> The Star Destroyer fleet itself did not attack the Rebels, however, having been ordered to stay back by the Emperor, who intended to reveal a surprise for the Rebels, using the fleet only to prevent the Rebels' escape. On the ''Executor'', Commander [[Merrejk]] informed Admiral Piett and Commander [[Gherant/Legends|Gherant]] that they were in attack position, but Piett told Merrejk to hold their position. When Gherant questioned why they were not going to attack, Piett informed him of the Emperor's orders and that he had something special planned. Meanwhile, Calrissian also noticed the Imperial fleet's relative inaction despite having a clear tactical advantage in taking out the Rebels and got suspicious.

[[File:ItsATrap-TheShadowSyndicate.jpg|214x214px|thumb|left|It's a trap!]]
Soon, the "surprise" that the Emperor alluded to his officers earlier was revealed to be demonstrating the battle station's operability: the Death Star II fired its main superlaser on [[Liberty/Legends|''Liberty'']], destroying it. The Rebels, having believed that the Death Star's weapons systems were not yet operational, were shocked. Ackbar ordered a retreat, though Calrissian talked him out of it, reminding the admiral that this was their only chance to take out the Death Star II. Ackbar ended up agreeing, with Calrissian suggesting to Admiral Gial Ackbar that the Rebel fleet attack the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]] at point-blank range, hoping that the Death Star would hold fire to prevent destroying Imperial ships, and if that didn't work, they'd at least take a few of the Imperial vessels with them. Soon, the two sides were engaging each other at ranges little more than a few hundred meters, and the Death Star did limit its fire,<ref name="ROTJ" /> though it still destroyed the Bulk Cruiser ''[[Urjani]]''<ref name="XWA" />, the escort frigate ''[[Redemption/Legends|Redemption]]''<ref name="TOSAVC38">[[Star Wars: The Official Starships & Vehicles Collection 1|''Star Wars: The Official Starships & Vehicles Collection'' 1]]</ref>, and an [[unidentified MC80 Home One type Star Cruiser|MC80 ''Home One'' type Star Cruiser]].<ref name="ROTJ" /> The resulting strategy was also chaotic for both sides, largely because the scale and usage for [[broadside battle]]s had been unprecedented.<ref name="ROTJn" /> Calrissian's strategy along with the X-wing squadron and Mon Calamari ship's firepower also resulted in the destruction of two of the Star Destroyers.<ref name="SW:RSII:RL" />

{{GameMechanics|legends=1|Star Wars: Rogue Squadron II: Rogue Leader}}
Around the time Calrissian targeted the two Star Destroyers, he also located and procured a case of homing cluster missiles that were floating in space.
{{EndGame}}
[[File:Xwing-cover-art.png|thumb|right|250px|Alliance and Imperial forces clash over Endor]]
Even with the Death Star's decreased rate of fire, the Imperial fleet still outnumbered and outgunned the Alliance and with the fleet in their path and interdictor fields raised and generated by [[Immobilizer 418 Interdictor-class Heavy Cruiser|Immobilizer-418s]] in the outer system, retreat was not an option for the Alliance. Furthermore, Calrissian pointed out to Ackbar that they would not get another chance at destroying the Death Star in its incomplete and vulnerable state.<ref name="ROTJ" />

As the enemy TIE fighters were launched, they swarmed against Admiral Ackbar's flagship, ''Home One''. As a result, Ackbar needed to bring in X2 for aid. After destroying the enemy fighters, X2 was called to ''Home One'', as it had been boarded by Imperial troopers. He and Ackbar defended the ship's reactor core from a group of stormtroopers, and X2 eliminated the invading troopers. Once the cruiser was secured, X2 proceeded to Endor's surface.<ref name="ES" />

In the course of the battle, the Alliance engaged the Empire's main [[communications ship]], the [[Battlecruiser/Legends|battlecruiser]] [[Pride of Tarlandia/Legends|''Pride of Tarlandia'']], which was generating the jamming that was hampering Rebel communications, and providing communications support to coordinate [[Death Squadron/Legends|Death Squadron]]. The [[181st Imperial Fighter Wing/Legends|181st Imperial Fighter Wing]] led by [[Baron of the Empire/Legends|Baron]] [[Soontir Fel/Legends|Soontir Fel]] flew in defense of the ''Pride of Tarlandia'' and inflicted severe casualties on [[Green Squadron (Rebel Alliance)/Legends|Green]] and [[Blue Squadron (Rebel Alliance)/Legends|Blue Squadrons]]. However, Fel was receiving contradictory orders and the Alliance concentrated its starfighters on the ''Tarlandia'', outnumbering the 181st and allowing [[Gemmer Sojan/Legends|Gemmer Sojan]], a [[Rogue Squadron/Legends|Rogue Squadron]] veteran flying as [[Green Two/Legends|Green Two]], to destroy the ship with his A-wing. The loss of the ''Pride of Tarlandia'' caused the jamming to vanish and disrupted the Empire's communications. The ''Pride of Tarlandia'' was also the second-in-command for the fleet after the [[Executor/Legends|''Executor'']], and with its loss, the Star Destroyer [[Chimaera/Legends|''Chimaera'']] became the next ship in line.<ref name="EGTW" />

[[File:Return_of_Jedi_Death_Star_fighters.png|thumb|300px|Scythe Squadron and Saber Squadron pursue the Alliance starfighters into the Death Star II.]]
After receiving word that the Rebel strike team had destroyed the shield generator, Admiral Ackbar ordered the fighter squadrons to commence their attack on the Death Star's main reactor. Taking advantage of the new tactical situation, General Calrissian led all of the remaining fighters of [[Red Squadron (Rebel Alliance)/Legends|Red]] and [[Gold Squadron (Rebel Alliance)/Legends|Gold]] Squadrons into the Death Star's superstructure, with several TIE Fighters and TIE Interceptors belonging to [[Scythe Squadron/Legends|Scythe Squadron]] and the [[181st Imperial Fighter Wing/Legends|181st Imperial Fighter Wing]] in pursuit. One TIE fighter crashed when it bumped into some wall pipes within the Death Star. {{GameMechanics|legends=1|Star Wars: Rogue Squadron II: Rogue Leader}}
During this time, Calrissian spotted specs for an advanced targeting computer lodged in some support pipes, and procured it for later use.
{{EndGame}}
After [[Keir Santage/Legends|Keir Santage]] was shot down by pursuing TIE Interceptors when going through the reactor tunnel, General Calrissian ordered most of the surviving fighters to split up and head back to the surface to draw away several of the fighters. Ultimately, this worked, leaving only two TIEs to pursue the ''Millennium Falcon'' and Antilles. The ''Millennium Falcon'' suffered minor damage when Lando Calrissian, while navigating through the battlestation, accidentally scraped the ''Millennium Falcon'' against the overhead, which knocked the vessel's [[Rectenna/Legends|rectenna]] clean off.<ref name="ROTJ" />

[[File:Insider221-Subscribercover-cropped.png|thumb|left|250px|The ''Millennium Falcon'' enters the Death Star II superstructure.]]
In order to dissuade more Imperials from swarming the Rebel fighters within the Death Star's superstructure, Ackbar ordered a concentrated assault on the Imperial flagship, the ''Executor'', in order to buy Calrissian more time. As Ackbar gave this order, one of the Star Destroyers also exploded in a huge fireball. Green Squadron [[RZ-1 A-wing interceptor/Legends|A-wings]] provided support for the ''Home One'' by disabling the [[Ion cannon/Legends|ion cannons]] on three Star Destroyers. One of the Star Destroyers was severely damaged by a [[Ramming/Legends|ramming]] attack from a [[CR90 corvette/Legends|CR90 corvette]].<ref name="Rebel Strike" /> With a combined effort of the entire Rebel flotilla of capital ships, the bridge shields were temporarily brought down. Admiral Piett, upon being notified of this, ordered for them to intensify the turbolasers' forward firepower to compensate for the new vulnerability, to prevent them from coming through.<ref name="ROTJ" />

Several fighter squadrons targeted the ''Executor''{{'s}} main sensors. After [[Jake Farrell/Legends|Jake Farrell]]—[[Green Four/Legends|Green Four]]—destroyed one of the giant sensor spheres, [[Green Leader/Legends|Green Leader]] [[Arvel Crynyd/Legends|Arvel Crynyd]] attempted to perform a [[Trench Run Defense|trench run]] across the ''Executor''{{'s}} dorsal cityscape, and destroyed several turbolasers before his fighter took critical damage from a turbolaser hit. Crynyd steered his crippled fighter into the ''Executor''{{'s}} bridge. Gherant witnessed Crynyd's A-wing approaching the bridge and attempted to warn his superior, Piett, about how it's too late to intensify the firepower, causing them both to duck into one of the crew pits as the A-wing crashed through. This cataclysmically destroyed much of the command bridge, killing all of the bridge command staff. Before the secondary command center could regain control of the ship, the ''Executor'' was caught by the second Death Star's gravity well, and was consequently pulled toward the battle station. It crashed into the surface of the Death Star, exploding into a ball of fire and killing every remaining officer and crewman on board.<ref name="ROTJ" /><ref name="Rebel Strike" />

Moff Jerjerrod, remembering his orders from the Emperor to destroy the moon if the shield was brought down, rotated the Death Star toward Endor. The Rebel fighters, led by the ''Millennium Falcon'', sped to the space station's reactor at its center. Jerjerrod responded by flooding the area with interference to hinder the Rebels' progress, and presumably issued an evacuation order to the battle station's non-essential crew, which included [[Scimitar Squadron (Imperial)/Legends|Scimitar]] [[TIE/sa tactical bomber/Legends|TIE/sa bomber]] [[Squadron/Legends|squadron]] members Captain [[Jonus/Legends|Jonus]] and Major [[Rhymer/Legends|Rhymer]]. After this, Ackbar ordered that all ships be moved away from the Death Star, sensing that soon it would be destroyed.<ref name="ROTJ" />

Likewise, Wedge Antilles and General Calrissian arrived at the Death Star's main reactor chamber. Antilles targeted the reactor core's power regulator with [[Proton torpedo/Legends|proton torpedoes]] while Calrissian targeted the core itself, then rushed out of the core tunnel and narrowly escaped just as the core erupted behind them. The pursuing TIE interceptors, however, were unable to evade the resulting fireball, being destroyed as they pursued the ''Millennium Falcon'' close to the exit.<ref name="ROTJ" />

While the Imperials had led the Rebels into a trap, they were unaware of who truly controlled the Death Star. In the years beforehand, the [[Droid/Legends|droid]] [[IG-88 assassin droid/Legends|IG-88]], a feared [[Assassin/Legends|assassin]] and [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]], had prepared to launch a [[Droid Revolution|droid revolution]]. The last surviving model, [[IG-88A/Legends|IG-88A]], built a duplicate of the Death Star's computer core and switched its fake one for the real system, transferring his consciousness into the computer. When the Imperials installed the core, IG-88A literally became the Death Star, with complete access to and control of all systems. None of the Imperial personnel knew, although Palpatine suspected a foreign presence when a series of doors in his throne room opened and closed mysteriously. When the Rebels arrived, IG-88A fired the superlaser at the Rebel fleet when the Death Star gunners sent the signal to do so, letting the Imperials believe they were in control, while he prepared to transmit his master control signal that would cause all droids to turn on their masters. Many times, the aiming points and the firing coordinates of the gunners were slightly off and would have missed their intended targets had IG-88 not been in command to guarantee accuracy.<ref name="TIA:TTOIG88" />

===Demise of the Sith===
{{Quote|You were right. You were right about me. Tell your sister… you were right.|The redeemed Anakin Skywalker to his son, Luke|<ref name="ROTJ" />}}
Meanwhile, just prior to the Endor strike team's failed assault into the shield generator bunker, Darth Vader brought Luke Skywalker to the Emperor's observation tower within the Death Star. There, Darth Sidious planned to turn Luke to the dark side of the Force and install him as his new [[Sith apprentice/Legends|apprentice]] in Vader's place. Vader also planned on turning Luke, but intended to use his son to help him kill Sidious. Upon witnessing Luke and Vader's arrival, Sidious, after welcoming Luke, removed Luke's [[Binders/Legends|binders]] and dismissed the present [[Emperor's Royal Guard/Legends|Royal Guardsmen]] from the throne room.<ref name="ROTJ" />

When Sidious taunted Luke with what he believed to be the inevitability of Luke's fall, Luke implied that everyone on the Death Star, including himself and the Emperor, would soon be dead. Chuckling, Sidious revealed that the Rebels were walking into a carefully orchestrated trap; Palpatine had provided the Rebels with all the information they had on the Death Star, including the construction site, the location of the planet-side shield generator, and (false) information on the station's operational status. He also informed Luke that he had stationed a legion of his best troops at the shield generator, and that as such, the small Rebel strike team on Endor had virtually no chance of deactivating the Death Star's shield before the Rebel fleet arrived.<ref name="ROTJ" />

Shortly thereafter, the Rebel fleet attacked and was trapped between the shielded Death Star and Death Squadron. With the Rebel fleet in dire straits, Sidious [[Dun Möch/Legends|taunted]] the young Jedi with the inevitable destruction of the Alliance and the deaths of all his friends. Luke, helpless to aid his comrades, grew enraged and glanced down at his [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]], sitting on the armrest of the Emperor's throne. Noticing Luke's gaze, Palpatine goaded Luke to take the lightsaber and strike him down. Luke, despite his anger, remained defiant and refused to be baited, although Sidious indicated that Luke's fall would be inevitable.<ref name="ROTJ" />

However, the Dark Lord still had one more card to play. He revealed to Luke that the Death Star's primary weapons systems were in fact operational, and ordered Jerjerrod to pick off Rebel capital ships at his leisure. Luke, his emotions mounting, glanced down at his weapon a second time, and the Emperor repeated his challenge to Luke to strike him down. Luke turned back towards the viewport through which he had been observing the battle, but several seconds later, suddenly turned back towards Sidious and summoned his weapon with the Force. Igniting it, he struck out at Sidious, only to have his blow intercepted by Vader as the Emperor cackled in triumph.<ref name="ROTJ" />

[[File:Conflict_and_Combat_FDCR.png|thumb|right|250px|Luke Skywalker and Darth Vader duel in the Emperor's throne room.]]
Luke and Vader [[Lightsaber duel/Legends|dueled]] atop the dais, with neither of them gaining any advantage for a considerable period. After a time, Luke suddenly intensified his attack, forcing a surprised Vader to retreat to the head of the stairs leading up to the dais. Taking advantage of Vader's precarious position, Luke kicked him in the chest, sending the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] careening down the stairs to land in a heap on the floor below. Seeing the power of Luke's anger, Sidious approvingly told Luke to continue drawing on his hate and anger as Vader regained his feet. The Dark Lord's words broke through Luke's anger, and he deactivated his lightsaber, calming himself and refusing to play Sidious's game.<ref name="ROTJ" />

Witnessing Luke's discipline, Vader solemnly stated that [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan]] had taught Luke well and ascended the staircase towards his son. Luke refused to continue fighting and slowly backed away from Vader. Dismissing his son's declaration, Vader reached Luke in short order and struck at the young Jedi with [[Darth Vader's lightsaber/Legends|his lightsaber]], forcing Luke to reactivate his weapon. After a brief flurry of swordplay, Luke leapt away from Vader into the center of one of the data pods in Palpatine's throne room. Vader drove his lightsaber between two of the slots on the device in an attempt to stab Luke, but the young Jedi backflipped out of the pod and onto a catwalk behind him.<ref name="ROTJ" />

Safely away from Vader, Luke attempted to sway his father from the dark side, telling Vader that he was emotionally conflicted and that he retained some good within him. Vader denied the presence of any internal conflict, to which Luke responded by stating his belief that Vader would not kill him now when he had not been able to bring himself to do so on Bespin. However, Vader asserted that Luke underestimated the power of the dark side, and that if he would not fight, he would "meet his destiny." With that, Vader hurled his lightsaber at Luke. Luke ducked to the side quickly enough to avoid his father's crimson-bladed weapon, but the lightsaber sheared through several of the catwalk's support struts, destabilizing the section where Luke was standing. As the gantry fell, Luke slid down it and scurried beneath the dais as Sidious laughed. Vader strode down the stairs to where Luke had fallen, activating his reclaimed weapon as he did so.<ref name="ROTJ" />

As Vader reached the entry to the underside of the dais, Luke invited his father to follow him, claiming that he only wished to talk. Vader, however, believed that Luke was planning to ambush him and refused. To prove to Vader that he intended no treachery, Luke tossed his lightsaber out from under the dais, where it rolled to a stop at Vader's feet. Mocking Luke's foolishness in relinquishing his weapon, Vader picked it up and proceeded under the dais.<ref name="ROTJn" />

Vader stalked the shadows under the dais, but he could not find his son. After a short, fruitless search, Vader verbally attempted to draw Luke out of hiding, beginning with an assertion that Luke could not stay hidden forever. Luke, however, merely repeated his earlier insistence that he would not fight. Vader began to prey on Luke's strong emotions for his friends, telling him that giving himself to the dark side was the only way to save them. As Luke's fears for his friends grew, Vader [[Mind probe (Force power)/Legends|probed]] Luke's mind for more information about them that he could use to his advantage, and discovered that Luke had a twin sister. Derisively commenting on what he thought of Obi-Wan's decision to hide her lineage, he stated that, if Luke would not turn to the dark side, then perhaps his sister would.<ref name="ROTJ" />

With that, Luke's rage exploded. Using the Force to retrieve his lightsaber from Vader, Luke tapped into the dark side and used his hate and anger to boost his physical prowess. He attacked Vader with such intensity that their lightsabers, both of which contained synthetic crystals, began to short out.<ref name="ROTJn" /> Vader, taken completely off guard by Luke's sudden increase in power and aggression, was forced onto his back foot and quickly driven onto a short bridge between the throne room and the elevator.<ref name="Fightsaber: Jedi Lightsaber Combat">{{InsiderCite|62|Fightsaber: Jedi Lightsaber Combat}}</ref> Luke continued to hammer Vader with vicious power attacks until Vader lost his footing and collapsed against a railing on the side of the bridge. After a few more blows, Luke drove Vader's lightsaber aside with an undercut and brought his weapon down on Vader's wrist, severing Vader's weapon hand and causing him to collapse onto the floor.<ref name="ROTJn" />

[[File:Redemption_CIV.png|left|thumb|263x263px|Anakin Skywalker fulfills the prophecy as the Chosen One]]
As Luke held his defenseless father at bladepoint, he heard Sidious laughing and proclaiming his satisfaction with Luke's power. As Sidous betrayed Vader by ordering Luke to finish Vader and take his place at the Dark Lord's side, Luke removed his [[Cybernetics/Legends|prosthetic]] hand from his lightsaber and looked down at it. Glancing from it to the severed stump of Vader's own mechanical hand, Luke realized that he was on the brink of repeating Vader's destiny, and took a deep breath to calm himself. Deactivating his lightsaber and tossing it away, Luke proclaimed that he would never turn to the dark side, affirming his identity as a [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]]. Furious that he had failed to turn Luke,<ref name="ROTJ" /> as had been the case with [[Galen Marek]] [[2 BBY/Legends|six years earlier]],<ref name="TFU">''[[Star Wars: The Force Unleashed]]''</ref> Sidious proclaimed that, if Luke would not turn, he would die.<ref name="ROTJ" />

With that, Sidious unleashed a barrage of relatively low-intensity Force lightning at Luke, blasting him backwards into several fixtures on the floor in front of a chasm above the reactor core. Intending to torture Luke for his defiance, Sidious asserted that Luke was a fool and fired another low-intensity blast at Luke.<ref name="ROTJ" /> Luke attempted to use [[Tutaminis]] to absorb the attack, but his lack of training in the technique, coupled with Sidious's incredible power, resulted in failure.<ref name="ROTJn" /> The electricity struck Luke head-on as Sidious fired yet another blast, nearly forcing Luke over the fixtures upon which he was perched and into the chasm. The injured Darth Vader, who had by then regained his feet, approached Sidious from behind as the Dark Lord mocked Luke, claiming that Luke's own skills were no match for the power of the dark side. As Luke struggled to pull himself off the fixtures and away from the chasm, Sidious struck again and Luke fell to the ground. Snarling that Luke would pay the price for his refusal to turn, Sidious fired a continual barrage of lightning. As he writhed in agony on the floor, Luke pleaded with Vader to help him, but the conflicted Sith Lord did nothing.<ref name="ROTJ" />

After a few more moments of torture, Sidious ceased his barrage and informed Luke that his time had come. He resumed his attack, preparing to increase the power of his lightning to lethal intensity. However, unnoticed behind him, underneath the mantle of Darth Vader, Anakin Skywalker, unable to bear the sight of his son in agony, found himself in a position similar to that of twenty-three years earlier when he saved Sidious from [[Mace Windu/Legends|Mace Windu]], who was killed by the Emperor, and this brought to mind all of Anakin's painful memories. He had been unable to save [[Shmi Skywalker Lars/Legends|his mother]] twenty-six years earlier, three years later he had allowed Mace Windu to die under his master's power, he had murdered hundreds of Jedi, he had killed his former master and best friend, Obi-Wan Kenobi, and he had caused the death of his wife, Padmé Amidala, but he could save his son. Anakin Skywalker would not stand by and leave his son to fall. From that moment on, Darth Vader ceased to exist and Anakin Skywalker was reborn.<ref name="ROTJ" />

In a final, heroic act of self-sacrifice, rectifying his mistake of not helping Windu kill Sidious before, he grabbed Sidious from behind as the Dark Lord increased the power of his lightning to its maximum. The energy, however, flowed into Anakin and the Emperor as the latter was hoisted off his feet, sparing Luke. Screaming in pain, rage and disbelief, Sidious continued to fire his lightning at such intensity that Anakin's bones shone through [[Darth Vader's armor/Legends|his armor]], but it did nothing to stop him. Anakin’s love for his son and will to atone for his past sins allowed him to experience a state of [[Oneness/Legends|Oneness]] with the Force, the [[Light side of the Force/Legends|light side]] giving him all the strength he needed to physically restrain the Sith Lord and power through his lightning. <ref name="Star Wars Insider 101">[[Star Wars Insider 101|''Star Wars Insider'' 101]]</ref> Anakin staggered to the chasm above the reactor core and with his last ounce of strength, he hurled Sidious over the railing and into the abyss, the latter [[Dark side burst|exploding into Force energy]] shortly afterwards.<ref name="ROTJ" />

With its Dark Lord dead and his apprentice redeemed, the [[Order of the Sith Lords]] was no more. However, the great intensity of Sidious's lightning had shorted out most of the sensitive electronics in Anakin's suit and cybernetics, leaving him virtually helpless and on the brink of death. Luke, unwilling to leave his father behind, dragged Anakin's cumbersome, immobile body to his shuttle as a general evacuation of the Death Star II proceeded around them.<ref name="ROTJ" />

As they reached the shuttle, Luke stopped on the boarding ramp to catch his breath. Propping Anakin's torso up, he looked down at his father, who requested that Luke help him remove his mask. Luke urgently reminded his father that, without the mask, he would die, but Anakin knew that the damage to his cybernetics was irreparable. Now, all he wanted was to look at Luke without the ocular filters of his mask. He told Luke this, and the boy obliged him and slowly removed the mask that Anakin had worn for nearly half his life. His dying request fulfilled, Anakin told Luke to leave him and go, but Luke adamantly proclaimed that he would not, that he intended to save his father. But Anakin replied that Luke had already done so and asked him to let Leia know that, in the end, Luke had been right about him. With that, Anakin Skywalker died in his son's arms, finally free from the evil that had consumed him from the conclusion of the Clone Wars throughout the Galactic Civil War having fulfilling his role as the [[Chosen One/Legends|Chosen One]] who would bring balance to the Force.<ref name="ROTJ" />

===Final actions===
{{Quote|This is one victory that'll go down in history, for sure.|[[Col Serra]]|<ref name="ES" />}}
[[File:WedgeDeathStarIIEscape-SWCT.png|thumb|right|250px|Antilles' X-wing flees the Death Star moments before its destruction.]]
While Luke and Vader had been dueling, Wedge Antilles and Lando Calrissian had been approaching the main reactor. Antilles fired two proton torpedoes into the power regulator. Calrissian then loosed two [[Concussion missile/Legends|concussion missiles]] which scored a direct hit on the main reactor, causing a massive explosion. This ignited a chain reaction that ultimately destroyed the station. Luke escaped in Vader's shuttle just before the fireball reached the equatorial docking bays, while Wedge and Lando narrowly made it out of the superstructure before the station tore apart. The ground forces witnessed the explosion from the surface of Endor, with Solo becoming concerned about the possibility that Skywalker may not have escaped from the battle station prior to its destruction, although Organa confirmed that he had escaped, explaining that she felt it. Organa also confirmed that she loved Skywalker when Solo asked, with the latter deciding to let her go to Skywalker, although Organa then admitted that Skywalker was actually her brother before kissing a dumbfounded Solo.<ref name="ROTJ" />

With the Death Star's destruction and the cessation of fleet combat, there was only cleaning up to do for the Rebels. They landed a force of [[T3-B heavy attack tank|tanks]] and other weapons that, under the command of Brenn Tantor, mopped up the last of the Imperial presence on the moon with a direct assault on their base.<ref name="Star Wars: Force Commander" /> X2 captured the ion cannon command bunker and fired the weapon against several Star Destroyers. He and Col Serra then destroyed two AT-ATs heading toward the Ewok village.<ref name="ES" /> Finally, Renegade Squadron's soldiers captured the final three command posts on the surface, ending the Empire's control of the world.<ref name="RS" /> Meanwhile, Han Solo and the strike team, from an idea that Chewbacca inadvertently planted in the former's head regarding returning the ''Tydirium'' to the fleet, shortly after the destruction of the Endor Shield Generator bunker, disguised themselves as stormtroopers, with Solo disguising himself as an Imperial General, and utilized the ''Tydirium'' to land in the Star Destroyer [[Emancipator|''Accuser'']], then infiltrated the control bridge posing as Imperials who escaped from the ambush. Solo knocked out the commanding officer and sent every personnel member to evacuate from the Star Destroyer, promptly capturing it for the Rebel Alliance. Solo and Lieutenant Page were later called in by Ackbar and Mothma to debrief the situation as they captured the Star Destroyer, by that point renamed the ''Emancipator'', without consulting them first. When Ackbar congratulated Page on the success, and asked how they accomplished this, Page corrected him and stated that they didn't need to fire a single shot to take it over.<ref name="The Deposition of General Solo">{{WEGCite|story=The Deposition of General Solo|book=The Truce at Bakura Sourcebook}}</ref>

Having seen the destruction of the Empire's two most powerful weapons, the Imperial Fleet lost the stomach to fight and fled. After the destruction of the ''Executor'', and with the destruction of the ''Pride of Tarlandia'', command was supposed to pass from Fleet Admiral Piett to Admiral [[Horst Strage]], the commander of the ''Imperial''-class Star Destroyer [[Chimaera/Legends|''Chimaera'']], which was serving as the secondary command ship. However, Strage had been killed when an ion blast overloaded his neural shunt, and it was [[Gilad Pellaeon/Legends|Gilad Pellaeon]], acting captain of the ''Chimaera'', who ordered a retreat from Endor to [[Annaj/Legends|Annaj]], the [[Capital/Legends|capital]] of the [[Moddell sector/Legends|Moddell sector]].<ref name="TEA" /> He did this without the consent of Admiral Harrsk, a higher-ranking officer than Pellaeon, who at this point was injured and incommunicado in a [[Bacta tank/Legends|bacta tank]]. This would later lead to the Admiral's defection.<ref name="Truce" /> Pellaeon also abandoned [[Grand Admiral/Legends|Grand Admiral]] [[Osvald Teshik]], who escaped the destruction of the Death Star and instead of fleeing as his colleagues [[Miltin Takel]] and [[Afsheen Makati]] did, unsuccessfully tried to rally the fleet and fought on alone for three more hours. Finally, his flagship, ''[[Eleemosynary]]'', succumbed to barrages of ion cannon fire and was captured. He was later executed for war crimes by Rebel authorities.<ref name="WW:IGA" />

Had the Rebels failed to destroy the station, the end result would have been worse than anticipated, but surprisingly, it would have been an ill turn of events for the Empire as well. IG-88A was still planning to launch his droid revolution against the Empire. When the Death Star core exploded, all power was lost and the destruction of the station wiped out IG-88A for good.<ref name="TIA:TTOIG88" />

The battle was thus sealed for the Rebellion. Grand Admiral [[Mitth'raw'nuruodo/Legends|Thrawn]] theorized that with the death of Emperor Palpatine, the subtle influence he exercised on his troops through the Force disappeared, drastically reducing the Imperial Navy's fighting ability. However, Grand Admiral [[Nial Declann]] perished with Palpatine aboard the Death Star, and he had been using the rare [[Force power/Legends|Force power]] of [[Battle meditation/Legends|battle meditation]] to aid the Imperial Fleet.<ref name="WW:IGA" />

With the deaths of both Palpatine, the Emperor, and Darth Vader, the Supreme Commander, and the destruction of the Death Star, the Imperial leadership had been essentially decapitated, and the Empire had lost its most powerful weapon. Demoralized, the remaining Imperials retreated deeper into Imperial space, believing that the Rebels would not press the attack.<ref name="ROTJ" /> Despite having ultimately won the battle, the Alliance loses were still very heavy. One-fifth of the Alliance Fleet was destroyed, including several Mon Calamari cruisers and numerous smaller ships,<ref name="TTABSB">''[[The Truce at Bakura Sourcebook]]''</ref> and three-quarters of the surviving fleet was in need of extensive repairs. On the Imperial side, [[Death Squadron/Legends|Death Squadron]] had lost the ''Executor'', one of its two [[Battlecruiser/Legends|battlecruisers]], a [[Tector-class Star Destroyer|''Tector''-class Star Destroyer]], and fifteen of its thirty-three ''Imperial''-class Star Destroyers.<ref name="EGTW" />

==Aftermath==
{{Quote|Wesa free!|A Gungan shouting from the Theed celebration following the Battle of Endor|<ref name="ROTJ" />}}
[[File:VictoryOnEndor.jpg|left|thumb|231x231px|The Ewoks emerge victorious.]]
The Rebels and Ewoks celebrated during the night, an event occurring on thousands of planets across the galaxy, as they had accomplished their main goals. The Emperor was dead, and the Empire had been dealt a massive blow. In this glorious celebration, Leia revealed to Han that Luke was her brother. The celebration continued into the nighttime, with the Rebels rendezvousing at Bright Tree Village. The Ewoks later celebrated by utilizing helmets of stormtroopers and TIE pilots confiscated from the Imperial survivors as drums.<ref name="ROTJ" />

Shortly after his death, what little had remained of Anakin's organic body vanished into the Force, leaving behind only his cybernetics and armor. Despite this, Luke [[Funeral of Anakin Skywalker/Legends|created a funeral pyre]] for the armor in the traditional Jedi manner, and lit it as the Rebel celebration got underway. After the armor had all but burned away, Luke returned to Bright Tree Village, where most of the planetside Rebel commanders were celebrating. After warmly greeting both Leia and Han, Luke took a moment to gaze off into the distance, and saw the [[Force ghost/Legends|ghost]] of his father, along with the ghosts of Obi-Wan Kenobi and Yoda, standing on the platform whence he had just come. As all three looked on approvingly at Luke, he paused to exchange a brief smile with them before Leia arrived to bring him back to the celebration.<ref name="ROTJ" />

The remains of the Rebel Fleet screened the space directly above Bright Tree Village to prevent any debris from the Death Star blast from harming that area. However, some of the wreckage from the battle, including a Star Destroyer,<ref name="Marooned" /> remained on Endor for years afterward.<ref name="Fury">''[[Legacy of the Force: Fury]]''</ref> Over the next year after the battle, the scout trooper and his squad sent to the far side of the moon remained in their positions, despite slowly dying one by one. After [[5 ABY/Legends|12 months]], the scout trooper deserted his post and traveled around Endor for a month. Meanwhile, the rebel trooper who got lost after relieving himself also remained on the moon; the two running into each other, neither knowing who won the battle. They briefly fought but made a truce and eventually found their way back to the shield generator, discovering that it had been destroyed and the Rebels had won the battle. Finding power running in the wreckage of a downed Star Destroyer, the pair were able to call for help, but when a passing ship arrived, only the Rebel trooper boarded, as the scout trooper decided that he didn't belong in the Rebellion's new, peaceful society, instead staying on Endor.<ref name="Marooned" />

After the battle, the [[Emperor's Hand/Legends|Emperor's Hand]] operative [[Mara Jade Skywalker|Mara Jade]] oversaw an alternate-history simulation of the battle. The simulation ended with the capture of Solo and Organa and the destruction of the Rebel Starfleet.<ref name="SW:GB">''[[Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds]]''</ref> The Empire attempted to release a cover story about their devastating defeat at Endor. However, they didn't get that chance, as the Rebel Alliance transmitted the feed of the full details of the battle. As a result, upon hearing of the Emperor's death, citizens on many worlds, such as Naboo and Tatooine, staged various uprisings celebrating the death of Emperor Palpatine and [[Lord/Legends|Lord]] Vader and the defeat of the Imperial Fleet at Endor. At least the [[Rally on Naboo/Legends|Naboo]]<ref name="ROTJ" /> and the [[Rebellion on Tatooine|Tatooine]] uprisings galvanized anti-Imperial sentiment,<ref name="DFS3">{{Wizards|url=default.asp?x=starwars/article/sw20050512b|series=The Dark Forces Saga|text=Part 3: Pride of the Dark Side}}</ref> even though some of them were crushed.<ref name="TEA" /> [[Liberation of Bespin|Bespin was liberated]] by Lando Calrissian several days after the battle;<ref name="ES" /> its inhabitants also celebrated the major Rebel victory. The celebrations, and the violence that came with them, spread to [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], then called Imperial Center, where citizens staged an [[Coruscant uprising|uprising]] upon hearing of the Emperor's death. They set off fireworks, attacked Imperial forces in the streets, toppled statues of Palpatine, and desecrated other symbols of the Empire.<ref name="ROTJ" /> However, the Empire cracked down on the celebrations, killing citizens and covert Rebels before order was restored.<ref name="Xw:IF">''[[X-Wing: Iron Fist]]''</ref> The [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] finally invaded Coruscant and [[Liberation of Coruscant (Galactic Civil War)|liberated]] its people from Imperial rule a little over two years later.<ref name="Xw:WG">''[[X-Wing: Wedge's Gamble]]''</ref>

[[File:DeathStarIIDebris-EGTW.jpg|thumb|right|242x242px|The debris of the second Death Star orbits Endor]]
[[Death Squadron/Legends|Death Squadron]] regrouped and repaired near [[Annaj/Legends|Annaj]] following the battle, and its surviving commanders fell to debating the next course of action. Gilad Pellaeon urged a return to Endor: he believed that despite their losses, Death Squadron remained powerful enough to overcome them. Pellaeon was countermanded by Admiral [[Blitzer Harrsk]], speaking from his [[Bacta tank/Legends|bacta tank]], who regarded Pellaeon's tactical command as nullified with the end of the battle. Command now belonged to Admiral [[Adye Prittick]], who notified the rest of the Empire of the crushing defeat. However, Prittick dithered for so long over a decision that Harrsk broke with the fleet, taking the [[Battlecruiser/Legends|battlecruiser]] ''[[Ilthmar's Fist]]'' and five Star Destroyers into the [[Deep Core/Legends|Deep Core]] until a clear chain of command could be established. This prompted two [[Captain/Legends|captains]] from the [[Elrood sector/Legends|Elrood sector]] to return there to await orders. This left Death Squadron with just twelve Star Destroyers, a force that Prittick judged too small to guarantee victory. He ordered a withdrawal to [[Yag'Dhul/Legends|Yag'Dhul]] to guard against a strike into the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]].<ref name="EGTW" />

The Alliance of Free Planets, and soon thereafter, the New Republic, was soon formed from the Rebel Alliance,<ref name="NEC" /> and during the years immediately following the Battle of Endor, heroes of the Rebellion like Wedge Antilles traveled around the galaxy to drum up support for the burgeoning Republic.<ref name="X-Wing: Rogue Squadron" /> Luke Skywalker would fulfill his destiny by creating the [[New Jedi Order]], eventually becoming its [[Grand Master/Legends|Grand Master]] and training many students in the Jedi ways, including many heroes of Endor and their offspring.<ref name="Jedi vs. Sith">[[Jedi vs. Sith: The Essential Guide to the Force (real-life book)|''Jedi vs. Sith: The Essential Guide to the Force'']]</ref> Endor would soon become a battlefield again, when the [[Nagai/Legends|Nagai]] invaded the world, though the [[Alliance of Free Planets]] [[Second Battle of Endor|defeated]] the invaders and set up its base on Endor.<ref name="Star Wars 100">[[Star Wars (1977) 100|''Star Wars'' (1977) 100]]</ref>

What started as a trap to eliminate the Rebellion once and for all became the start of the Empire's downfall and demise. While the Empire continued to exist for many years after the Battle of Endor, it entered a state of decline, and did not revert to its original state. The disintegration and collapse of the Galactic Empire began shortly after the Battle of Endor as news of the Emperor's death became widespread.<ref name="ROTJ" /> Palpatine had planned to rule the galaxy indefinitely, and as such he had not established any plans for a successor. Compounding this confusion was the fact that Vader, the Emperor's right hand and de-facto successor as Supreme Commander, had perished with Palpatine. With the two Sith Lords dead, numerous Imperial potentates carved out personal fiefdoms. This decay and collapse accelerated in 11 ABY after the resurrected Emperor's final death.<ref name="EE2">[[Empire's End 2|''Empire's End'' 2]]</ref> Years later, the small [[Imperial Remnant/Legends|Imperial Remnant]] signed a [[Pellaeon–Gavrisom Treaty|peace treaty]].<ref name="VOTF">''[[Vision of the Future]]''</ref>

[[File:JediGhosts-ROTJ.png|thumb|left|250px|Luke saw the Force ghosts of Anakin, Obi-Wan, and Yoda in the celebration following the battle.]]
Though Rebel Alliance and its successor governments extolled their victory during the Battle of Endor, they were not the only ones to utilize the Battle of Endor for propaganda purposes. Although the battle dealt a devastating blow to the Empire, efforts were made to give it a pro-Imperial spin. In one case, Imperial agents stated that the Ewoks had been [[Endor disaster|annihilated]] following the battle. Also, a [[Galactic Museum/Legends|Galactic Museum]] exhibit presented the second Death Star as a weapon of the Rebel Alliance, rather than the Empire, and portrayed Palpatine and Vader as heroes who sacrificed themselves to destroy the battle station after attempts at peaceful negotiations failed. Although it presented a far stretch from the truth, even Wedge Antilles, who visited the exhibit while undercover on Coruscant, felt it was as compelling as the true history.<ref name="Xw:WG" /> Similarly, the duel between Vader and Luke was later "adapted" into a [[holothriller]] film called ''[[Luke Skywalker and the Jedi's Revenge]]'', under the orders of Lord [[Cronal]], the former [[Director of Imperial Intelligence]] as part of a means of manipulating the newfound free speech to promote Imperial values. Skywalker, after watching the holofilm, expressed disgust at the ending, which depicted Skywalker killing Darth Vader to avenge Emperor Palpatine, and also cited most of the film's historical inaccuracies.<ref name="Shadows of Mindor">''[[Luke Skywalker and the Shadows of Mindor]]''</ref>

As late as [[41 ABY]], the aging Luke Skywalker and his [[Jedi Coalition|allies]] were [[Second Galactic Civil War|fighting]] a new [[Lumiya's Sith|Sith Order]] led by [[Darth Caedus]], Darth Vader's grandson. After escaping from Coruscant, the Jedi used the former Imperial [[Jedi Outpost|outpost]] from the Battle of Endor.<ref name="Fury" /><ref name="Revelation">''[[Legacy of the Force: Revelation]]''</ref> In a costly mistake, Caedus refused to search for Luke Skywalker on places such as Hoth or Endor that reminded the Jedi Master of his Rebel years. Eventually, though, Caedus's fate was like that of his Sith predecessors, as he was [[Battle of Uroro Station|killed]] and later redeemed, and peace was restored to the galaxy once again.<ref name="Invincible">''[[Legacy of the Force: Invincible]]''</ref> During the same time, a reporter named [[Cindel Towani]] interviewed a surviving stormtrooper from the battle, where he explained to her the atrocities the Ewoks caused during the battle.<ref name="EGTW" />

The deaths of Vader, Palpatine and the destruction of the Death Star II caused a [[Wound in the Force/Legends|wound in the Force]] so intense that it caused Leia to collapse when she returned to Endor [[9 ABY/Legends|five years later]].<ref name="DFR">''[[Dark Force Rising]]''</ref>

The victory at Endor would be celebrated for many years after the battle on a holiday called [[Endor Day]].

==Notable participants==

[[File:Emperor_Sidious.png|thumb|right|65px|Palpatine]]

As Sidious, he planned to turn Luke Skywalker to the dark side of the Force, and had Darth Vader capture him. He set up a deadly lightsaber duel between Luke and Vader, and tempted the young Jedi to kill his weak father. When Skywalker refused, Sidious used [[Force lightning/Legends|Force lightning]] to nearly kill him. Darth Vader, finally redeeming himself, threw Sidious down the Death Star's reactor shaft, killing the Emperor and ending his menace.<ref name="ROTJ" /> Palpatine's death threw the Empire into disarray; even when he returned as a [[Cloning/Legends|clone]] [[10 ABY/Legends|six years later]],<ref name="DE2">[[Dark Empire 2|''Dark Empire'' 2]]</ref> the Empire never recovered from his death.<ref name="TEA" />

There, he dueled his son, and although the cyborg used the power of the dark side and tempted his opponent, he lost the duel and was at the mercy of his offspring. When Sidious [[Torture/Legends|tortured]] Luke for not killing Vader, Vader was torn, and finally killed his [[Sith Master/Legends|Sith Master]] by throwing him into the Death Star's reactor.
